title: The Empty Council Seat
recap: On an earlier night the minions voted a household object onto the Dread Council; whatever it does now is their doing.

states.summary: A seat on the Dread Council stands empty and the bylaws allow any object of standing to fill it

vote.question: Which household object takes the empty Council seat?

states.summary: The Kettle sits on the Dread Council by the minions' vote
states.payoff: Councillor Kettle obstructs tonight's scheme: every decree must now be submitted to it, and it only whistles

states.summary: The Mop sits on the Dread Council by the minions' vote
states.payoff: Councillor Mop obstructs tonight's scheme: it has mopped the war table clean of every plan and demands a recount

states.summary: The Kettle was impeached by the minions' vote
states.payoff: The Kettle's impeachment is entered in the Grudge Ledger; the scheme it blocked resumes, slightly scalded

states.summary: The Kettle was crowned by the minions' vote
states.payoff: The Kettle now outranks him on paper; he serves it tea out of spite and resumes the scheme in its name

states.summary: The Mop was impeached by the minions' vote
states.payoff: The Mop's impeachment is entered in the Grudge Ledger; the war table is dirty again and the scheme resumes

states.summary: The Mop was crowned by the minions' vote
states.payoff: The Mop now outranks him on paper; the scheme resumes under its spotless, damp authority

transitions.announce: The Kettle is sworn onto the Dread Council; its first act will be felt on the next night
